hypothesis: Original failures may reflect optimization/difficulty rather than capacity or FP16 failure. A full single-operation training fit separates these explanations.
intervention: 2x2 learning rate (0.0002/0.002) and precision (FP16/FP32), otherwise identical atomic task
dataset: All 1587 ordered one-operation expressions over F23; original token format and independent formula/oracle checks
split: Per operator fixed shuffle seed4242: 423 train,53 validation,53 reserved test; new models trained from scratch; original length10 test untouched
primary_metric: Full atomic training accuracy at step4000, higher is better; validation and operator scores secondary
decision_rule: Training accuracy >=99% establishes basic fit; validation >=50% establishes useful atomic generalization for this diagnostic only. Compare paired LR and precision changes >=10 percentage points. Do not expand to long expressions until fit gate passes. Choose follow-up by validation CE among fit-passing configurations, then freeze a separate task.
code_revision: Record clean git HEAD at each launch
